quote: And there's nothing wrong with being a lizard either. Unless you were born to be a hawk.
author: Leigh Bardugo

quote: But that one moment holding the quarterstaff sang to him. A single moment of clarity in an otherwise confusing world.
author: Brandon Sanderson

quote: Sometimes we find it hardest to accept in others that which we cling to in ourselves.
author: Brandon Sanderson

quote: Expectation wasn't just about what people expected of you. It was about what you expected of yourself.
author: Brandon Sanderson

quote: Sometimes a hypocrite is nothing more than a man in the process of changing.
author: Brandon Sanderson

quote: He hadn't changed in one giant leap, but across a million little steps.
author: Brandon Sanderson

quote: Do not dismiss your own talents because you envy those of another.
author: Brandon Sanderson

quote: Suffering is cheap as clay and twice as common; What matters is what each man makes of it.
author: Leigh Bardugo

quote: To lack feeling is to be dead, but to act on every feeling is to be a child.
author: Brandon Sanderson

quote: Accept the pain, but don't accept that you deserved it.
author: Brandon Sanderson

quote: He felt good lots of days. Trouble was, on the bad days, that was hard to remember. At those times, for some reason, he felt like he had always been in that darkness, and always would be.
author: Brandon Sanderson

quote: The world is monstrous at times, and there are those who would have you believe that you are terrible by association. I am. No. For you see, it flows the other direction. You are not worse for your association with the world, but it is better for its association with you.
author: Brandon Sanderson

quote: You're always willing to give others more charity than you extend yourself.
author: Brandon Sanderson

quote: The quality of our lives is not measured by the amount of time we spend in a state of perfection.
book: Burnout - The Secret to Unlocking the Stress Cycle
author: Emily and Amelia Nagoski

quote: Life before Death. Strength before Weakness. Journey before Destination.
author: Brandon Sanderson

quote: There is no greater indication of youth, perhaps, than the desire for everything to be as it should.
author: Brandon Sanderson

quote: To be human is to seek beauty, Shallan. Do not despair, do not end the hunt because thorns grow in your way.
author: Brandon Sanderson

quote: You tried to help the people of the market. You mostly failed. This is life. The longer you live, the more you fail. Failure is the mark of a life well lived. In turn, the only way to live without failure is to be of no use to anyone. Trust me, I've practiced.
author: Brandon Sanderson

quote: Life breaks us, Teft. Then we fill the cracks with something stronger.
author: Brandon Sanderson

quote: The trick to happiness wasn’t in freezing every momentary pleasure and clinging to each one, but in ensuring one’s life would produce many future moments to anticipate.
author: Brandon Sanderson

quote: The most important word a man can say are, "I will do better.”
author: Brandon Sanderson

quote: You can’t spend forever floating between worlds, Cousin, she thought. Eventually you’ll need to decide where you want to belong. Life was so much harder, but potentially so much more fulfilling, when you found the courage to choose.
author: Brandon Sanderson

quote: You should try to understand what they want out of life, and respect that, rather than projecting onto them what you think they should want out of life.
author: Brandon Sanderson

quote: It will, Wit said, but then it will get better. Then it will get worse again. Then better. This is life, and I will not lie by saying every day will be sunshine. But there will be sunshine again, and that is a very different thing to say. That is truth. I promise you, Kaladin: You will be warm again.
author: Brandon Sanderson

quote: Go to bed; tired is stupid.
author: Ursula K. Le Guin

quote: So laying eggs all your life and then getting plucked, stuffed and roasted is good enough for you, is it?

The condition of all who are preoccupied is wretched, but most wretched is the condition of those who labor at preoccupations that are not even their own.
author: Seneca

quote: Whatever comes, face it on your feet.
author: Robert Jordan

quote: We say we are scared by failure, but what frightens us more is the possibility of success.
author: Julia Cameron

quote: Somebody has to start. Somebody has to step forward and do what is right, because it is right.
author: Brandon Sanderson

quote: Power was an illusion of perception, as Jasnah had said. The first step to being in control was to see yourself as capable of being in control.
author: Brandon Sanderson

quote: Who do you think is stronger? The man who has walked easily his entire life, or the man with no legs? The man who must pull himself by his arms?
author: Brandon Sanderson

quote: Few men have the wisdom to realize when they need help. Fewer still have the strength to go get it.
author: Brandon Sanderson

quote: Strength could be a matter of perception sometimes. And today Shallan found she could choose strength.
author: Brandon Sanderson

quote: A virtue is something that is valuable even if it gives you nothing. A virtue persists without payment or compensation.
author: Brandon Sanderson

quote: Remember the flame, lad, and the void.
author: Robert Jordan

quote: We are always more afraid than we wish to be, but we can always be braver than we expect.
author: Robert Jordan

quote: You cannot create a piece of art merely for money. Doing it as part of commerce so denudes art of wonder that it ceases to be art.
author: Seth Godin

quote: The purpose of a storyteller is not to tell you how to think, but to give you questions to think upon.
author: Brandon Sanderson

quote: Beauty was out there, all around. To create art was not to capture it, but to participate in it.
author: Brandon Sanderson

quote: If you could explain something perfectly, then you’d never need art.
author: Brandon Sanderson

quote: Have you ever considered, bridgeman, that bad art does more for the world than good art? Artists spend more of their lives making bad practice pieces than they do masterworks, particularly at the start. And even when an artist becomes a master, some pieces don’t work out. Still others are somehow just wrong until the last stroke. You learn more from bad art than you do from good art, as your mistakes are more important than your successes. Plus, good art usually evokes the same emotions in people—most good art is the same kind of good. But bad pieces can each be bad in their own unique way. So I’m glad we have bad art, and I’m sure the Almighty agrees.
author: Brandon Sanderson

quote: Art is not art if it has a function.
author: Brandon Sanderson

quote: I am an artist, Wit said. I should thank you not to demean me by insisting my art must be trying to accomplish something. In fact, you shouldn’t enjoy art. You should simply admit that it exists, then move on. Anything else is patronizing.
author: Brandon Sanderson

quote: Perhaps the question isn’t ‘What use is art?’ Wit mused. Perhaps even that simple question misses the point. It’s like asking the use of having hands, or walking upright, or growing hair. Art is part of us, Kaladin. That’s the use; that’s the reason. It exists because on some fundamental level we need it. Art exists to be made.
author: Brandon Sanderson

quote: Nothing is just anything.
author: Philip Pullman

quote: Humans can see the world as it is not. It is why your lies can be so strong. You are able to not admit that they are lies.
author: Brandon Sanderson

quote: In my painful experience, the truth may be simple, but it is rarely easy.
author: Brandon Sanderson

quote: “Inappropriate?” Pattern said. “Such as … dividing by zero?”
author: Brandon Sanderson

quote: NO MATING.
author: Brandon Sanderson

quote: Your name is Lift, right? Right. And your order? More food.
author: Brandon Sanderson

quote: Journey before destination, you bastard.
author: Brandon Sanderson

quote: Evil can be unscrupulous, and good can’t. Evil has nothing to stop it doing what it wants, while good has one hand tied behind its back. To do the things it needs to do to win, it’d have to become evil to do ’em.
author: Philip Pullman

quote: Expectations were like fine pottery. The harder you held them, the more likely they were to crack.
author: Brandon Sanderson

quote: Do not let your assumptions about a culture block your ability to perceive the individual, or you will fail.
author: Brandon Sanderson

quote: One can believe in a story without believing it happened.
author: Brandon Sanderson

quote: But merely being tradition does not make something worthy, Kadash. We can't just assume that because something is old it is right.
author: Brandon Sanderson

quote: In all the history of mankind, has any conqueror decided they had enough? Has any man just said, ‘This is good. This is what I wanted,’ and gone home?
author: Brandon Sanderson

quote: Turned out that the end of the world had to actually arrive before people would take it seriously.
author: Brandon Sanderson

quote: You could not arrive at excellence by the average of these people. Excellence was an individual quest, not a group effort.
author: Brandon Sanderson

quote: If nobody asked questions, then we would never learn anything.
author: Brandon Sanderson

quote: It is not perfection we seek, for perfection is impossible. It is instead consistency.
author: Brandon Sanderson

quote: Creativity requires faith. Faith requires that we relinquish control.
author: Julia Cameron

quote: Each of us has an inner dream that we can unfold if we will just have the courage to admit what it is.
author: Julia Cameron

quote: Follow your bliss and doors will open where there were no doors before.
author: Joseph Campbell

quote: The Wheel of Time turns, and Ages come and pass, leaving memories that become legend. Legend fades to myth, and even myth is long forgotten when the Age that gave it birth comes again. In one Age, called the Third Age by some, an Age yet to come, an Age long past, a wind rose in the Mountains of Mist. The wind was not the beginning. There are neither beginnings nor endings to the turning of the Wheel of Time. But it was a beginning.
author: Robert Jordan
